replay_python:
rows=[]
for p in sorted((p for p in raw.rglob('*') if p.is_file()), key=lambda p: p.relative_to(raw).as_posix()):
    rows.append([p.relative_to(raw).as_posix(), p.stat().st_size, hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()])
census=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
